entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Oh, I hope someone can help me. I'm just so disappointed.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I hear you're having some trouble, how can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I bought this Aero Race jersey a little while ago, and I was so excited for it. I've been a loyal customer for years, you know? But it's just not right.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I finally got around to trying it on for a big ride and it's just... it's way too tight. I can barely zip it up. I thought about an exchange, but honestly, with things the way they are, I really need the money back.
I completely understand. Getting the fit right is the most important thing. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility for you. Can I get your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race jersey. It was delivered about 60 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Please, I really hope you can help. I was counting on this.
Okay, I have good news. Our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. We can definitely get a full refund started for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you, Alex.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've really made my day.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Was there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
